column1: # rlvm-machine/OWNERS.tsv - file ownership inside the module (enforced by scripts/machine-sandbox.sh).
# pattern<TAB>package. Patterns are relative to rlvm-machine/, bash globs (* also crosses /), FIRST MATCH WINS.
# A file that matches no line belongs to nobody: it is never published from a sandbox (this table itself is
# such a file: it is edited in the main tree only, through `scripts/machine-sandbox.sh claim WP PATH`).
# The module's notes are trees of the journal (*agentic-note*: rep-machine-ownership, rep-machine-work-packages,
# rep-machine-M1 .. rep-machine-M8, rep-machine-S, design-switches-document): no sandbox owns or publishes one.
# Naming conventions (the glob lines at the end): a package owns the test classes whose name starts with
# its key (src/test/java/rlvm/machine/M3*.java) and its test resources (src/test/resources/m3/**).
# New main classes are claimed with `claim`.
# ---- test tree: explicit files (shared test support belongs to M6; readback and equivalence to M8)
# ---- conventions (globs; keep them after every explicit line)
# ---- package S: the independent soundness review (wave 6; hostile exports and one test class asserting the official verdicts).
#      S*.java also matches Sexp.java and StepSizeTest.java, which have explicit M6 lines above (first match wins).
